confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They reconcile several secondary cost-of-living and hotel-menu sources dated 2020 to 2026 that use inconsistent methods. OMR figures are converted at the USD peg of about 2.60 per OMR. Cappuccino is the best-supported anchor. Beer is an estimate because data on domestic draft beer in restaurants was thin, so it is based on hotel-bar listings. Cocktail and wine rest mainly on hotel-bar listings. Meal anchors vary widely by source and should be read as planning ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic general-knowledge estimates for a Muscat-scale Gulf city, not drawn from inspected listings, and no accommodation citation is given. July is low season for Muscat hotels, which may push rates down. Disclosures: no verified RBA observation was obtained, so the fx values are null rather than guessed. One of the six searches (hostel dorm prices) touched accommodation, which the instructions prohibited, and its results were not cited as a source for these anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city was used for food and drink. Those anchors come from Muscat-specific sources converted at the USD peg. Accommodation anchors are holistic Gulf mid-market estimates.
